title: Find small, cheap items
prompt: Return the name and price of every product in category 4 or category 8 that costs 50 or less. A price of exactly 50 counts.
hints: The price limit applies to both categories. Which test would be applied first without brackets?
Put the two categories together, with IN or with brackets, then add the price test with AND.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Mixes OR and AND without brackets, so the price test applies to one category only.
Leaves out a price of exactly 50.

feedback: Check a product in category 4 that costs more than 50, and a product that costs exactly 50.
